scientific_states.SPATIALLY PAIRED: Real lunar scenes that share genuine spatial/geographic overlap between Chandrayaan-2 instruments.
scientific_states.GEOGRAPHICALLY ASSOCIATED: Nearest-neighbor counterpart tile selected from regional survey imagery based on lunar coordinate proximity.
scientific_states.MODEL VALIDATION PENDING: Real imagery is confirmed and spatially co-located, but dense learned feature correspondence inference and geometric validation have not yet been completed.
scientific_states.INTEGRATION PENDING: Multi-sensor registration bridge pipeline scheduled for deployment in the three-instrument release.
scientific_states.APPROXIMATE GEOMETRY: Pixel-to-lunar coordinate mapping derived from planning/visualization ephemeris rather than rigorous bundle-adjusted SPICE kernels.
scientific_states.SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK: High-fidelity synthetic rendering benchmark used to rigorously validate fine-adapted LoFTR performance under controlled sun-angle variations.
scientific_states.VALIDATED BENCHMARK: Empirically measured, peer-verifiable error metrics from 500+ controlled synthetic correspondence pairs.

limitations.title: Raw Product Calibration
limitations.detail: IIRS source products are currently ingested in Raw/Level-1 format; photometric shading and stray-light corrections are preliminary.

limitations.title: Approximate Lunar Geolocation
limitations.detail: The current pixel-to-lunar geometry (iirs_pixel_lat_lon_approx.npy) is for planning and visual correspondence demonstration; it is not yet tied to high-order SPICE SPK/CK kernels.

limitations.title: Synthetic Benchmark Scope
limitations.detail: Verified sub-pixel benchmark metrics (0.3801 px normal, 0.5458 px stress) represent the fine-adapted LoFTR model evaluated on synthetic IIRS pairs, not real-scene three-sensor accuracy.

limitations.title: TMC-2 / OHRC Model Integration
limitations.detail: TMC-2 to OHRC learned correspondence model fine-tuning is actively ongoing; real pair correspondence endpoints return explicit pending states to prevent data fabrication.

limitations.title: Three-Way Geometric Validation
limitations.detail: Full three-sensor closed-loop geometric validation (cycle consistency error < 1 px across IIRS-TMC2-OHRC) remains under development.

limitations.title: Geographic Pairing vs. Learned Validation
limitations.detail: Deterministic geographic pairing of scenes/tiles confirms geographic proximity, which is distinct from solved and validated feature correspondence.
